items.name: Community Development Block Grant — General Assistance
items.pays: Community needs: water and sewer, public facilities, and urgent needs.
items.who: Cities and counties (except the largest cities). A grant administrator is required.
items.size: $75,000 to $500,000; up to $1 million for water or sewer work that adds customers.

items.name: Rural Services Block Grant
items.agency: Arkansas Economic Development Commission — Rural Services
items.pays: Community centers, fire stations, and fire trucks.
items.who: Towns and rural communities under 3,000 people where most households are low-to-moderate income.

items.name: Arkansas Site Development Program
items.who: Cities, counties, and economic development groups that filed an intent to apply by Sept 30, 2026.

items.name: County Courthouse Restoration Grants
items.who: Counties with a historic courthouse. Letters of intent are open; applications open Nov 16, 2026.

items.name: Opioid settlement funds
items.who: Counties and cities; each project goes before the county judge and mayors.

items.name: Local Bridge Program
items.who: Counties and cities, by written request.

items.name: Water and wastewater funding
items.agency: Arkansas Department of Agriculture — Natural Resources Division
items.pays: State revolving fund loans (some principal forgiven) and other water programs.

help.text: The Arkansas Municipal League runs a grants service for cities.
help.label: Arkansas Municipal League
